rationale: Three minutes ago, the stock experienced a sudden, massive volume spike (over 920k shares in one minute) that drove price from $48.22 to $50.82 before immediately retracing half the move to $49.30. With the bid-ask spread expanded to 24.3 bps, one-minute ranges still exceeding $0.50-$1.40, and no confirmed catalyst in the feed to anchor valuation, price is digesting in the middle of the impulse candle where neither long continuation nor short reversion offers a clean risk-to-reward profile.
